name: Spell Sniper

prerequisites.text: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; spell attacks ignore partial cover and nearby enemies, and gain 60 feet of range.

benefits.name: Bypass Cover
benefits.summary: Your spell attack rolls ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
benefits.text: Your attack rolls for spells ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

benefits.name: Casting in Melee
benefits.summary: An enemy within 5 feet doesn't give you Disadvantage on spell attack rolls.
benefits.text: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells.

benefits.name: Increased Range
benefits.summary: Spells with a range of 10+ feet that need an attack roll can gain 60 feet of range.
benefits.text: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.
